overview.overview:
Nebraska is expected to vote Republican in 2028, with the forecast projecting a Republican margin of about 14.5 points. The state backed Donald Trump by 19.05 points in 2020 and by 20.46 points in 2024. Its lean runs about 20 points more Republican than the nation as a whole, which places it well inside Republican territory.

Current indicators point in the same direction. Statewide benchmarks from the 2026 midterms show Republican advantages of about 6 points in the Senate measure and 8 points in the governor measure. No public polls or candidate-specific information are available for this contest, so the outlook rests on past results and broader indicators. The plausible range runs from a Republican edge of roughly 5 points to one of about 24 points.
overview.watch: A sharp shift in statewide polling or a sustained change in the national environment would be needed to move the outlook meaningfully, and no such evidence is currently available.
key_factors: Republican margins of about 19 to 20 points in the 2020 and 2024 presidential elections
A lean roughly 20 points more Republican than the nation
Statewide 2026 midterm benchmarks showing Republican leads of about 6 to 8 points
No public polls are currently available for this contest
